job_description: About DTech Corporation Limited DTech Corporation Limited  is one of Bangladesh’s largest and most established façade engineering, fabrication, and installation companies. With over 30 years of industry experience and more than 300 successfully completed projects, DTech has built a strong reputation for delivering high-quality and innovative façade solutions for commercial, residential, industrial, institutional, and government developments. Our expertise includes curtain wall systems, structural glazing, ACP cladding, aluminum doors and windows, skylights, glass domes, canopies, spider glazing, architectural metalwork, and other customized building-envelope solutions. Position Summary DTech Corporation Limited  is seeking a highly experienced and technically capable Project Manager – Façade Engineering & Projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting and managing façade projects from system design and structural analysis through procurement, fabrication, installation, quality control, and final handover. The candidate will also oversee vendor coordination, labor management, project-level human resources activities, and quality-control operations across all projects of the company. Extensive practical experience in the façade industry is mandatory. Preference will be given to candidates with strong experience in façade system design, structural analysis, project execution, workforce supervision, and quality assurance. Key Responsibilities Project Management and Coordination Assist the Project Engineers in planning, executing, monitoring, and completing multiple façade projects. Prepare and monitor project schedules, work programs, budgets, manpower plans, procurement schedules, and resource allocations. Coordinate with clients, consultants, architects, structural engineers, main contractors, subcontractors, and internal departments. Conduct regular project meetings, site inspections, and progress reviews. Prepare progress reports, technical submissions, method statements, meeting minutes, variation documents, and project handover records. Identify project risks, delays, technical challenges, and resource shortages and implement corrective measures. Ensure projects are completed safely, within budget, according to specification, and within the approved timeframe. Façade System Design and Engineering The candidate must have the full technical capability to independently design, develop, detail, and coordinate façade systems, including: Stick Curtain Wall Systems Semi-Unitized Curtain Wall Systems Unitized Curtain Wall Systems General Sliding Systems Euro Sliding Systems Folding and Bifold Door Systems Structural Glazing Systems Spider Glazing Systems ACP Cladding Systems Glass Canopies Glass Domes Skylights Aluminum Doors and Windows Louvers Architectural Metalwork Customized Façade and Building-Envelope Systems The candidate will be expected to: Develop façade system concepts and technical details. Prepare and review shop drawings, fabrication drawings, cutting lists, and installation drawings. Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings for coordination. Prepare material take-offs, BOQs, and technical specifications. Coordinate design submissions and approvals with consultants and clients. Resolve technical, fabrication, and site-related design issues. Review system performance requirements, including wind load, deflection, water tightness, air tightness, thermal movement, and structural stability. Façade Structural Analysis Conduct or supervise structural analysis of façade systems and components. Perform calculations for wind pressure, structural loads, glass thickness, mullions, transoms, brackets, anchors, fasteners, and supporting members. Check deflection, stress, load transfer, and structural adequacy of façade components. Prepare or review structural calculation reports for consultant approval. Coordinate with structural engineers and testing agencies where required. Ensure all façade systems comply with applicable international codes, project specifications, and safety requirements. Preference will be given to candidates with proven hands-on experience using façade structural-analysis software or engineering calculation tools. Vendor and Procurement Management Identify, evaluate, appoint, and manage local and international vendors, suppliers, fabricators, and subcontractors. Obtain and compare technical and commercial quotations. Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, payment terms, warranties, and technical requirements. Ensure purchased materials comply with approved specifications, samples, and quality standards. Monitor supplier performance, material lead times, production status, and delivery schedules. Coordinate procurement activities with project schedules and site requirements. Maintain strong professional relationships with key suppliers and subcontractors. Address vendor-related quality, delivery, and contractual issues. Quality Control and Quality Assurance The Deputy Project Manager will oversee quality-control activities for all company projects and will be responsible for ensuring consistent standards from material procurement through project handover. Establishing and implementing project-specific QA/QC procedures. Inspecting incoming materials, aluminum profiles, glass, panels, accessories, sealants, hardware, and fasteners. Monitoring fabrication quality in the factory and installation quality at project sites. Ensuring all work complies with approved shop drawings, method statements, specifications, and samples. Preparing inspection checklists, inspection requests, quality reports, non-conformance reports, and corrective-action records. Coordinating mock-ups, performance tests, water tests, and other required façade testing. Conducting regular factory and site quality audits. Managing snagging, rectification, final inspection, and project handover. Training engineers, supervisors, technicians, and installers on quality requirements. Maintaining company-wide quality standards across all active projects. Labor and Workforce Management Plan and manage labor requirements for all projects. Allocate workers, technicians, installers, supervisors, and subcontractor teams according to project needs. Monitor labor attendance, productivity, discipline, performance, and efficiency. Ensure proper deployment of skilled and unskilled labor across project sites. Coordinate mobilization, transfer, accommodation, transportation, and demobilization of project labor where necessary. Resolve labor-related disputes, operational issues, and disciplinary matters. Ensure workers comply with company policies, safety procedures, quality requirements, and site regulations. Monitor subcontractor manpower and productivity. Coordinate training and skill development for installation and fabrication teams. Maintain accurate labor records, deployment plans, performance reports, and productivity data. Human Resources Responsibilities In addition to project responsibilities, the candidate will support selected HR functions related to technical and project personnel. Assist in recruiting engineers, supervisors, technicians, draftsmen, fabricators, installers, and project staff. Participate in interviews, technical assessments, and candidate evaluations. Support employee onboarding, orientation, deployment, and probation reviews. Assess staff performance and recommend confirmation, promotion, training, transfer, or disciplinary action. Help establish job responsibilities, reporting structures, and performance targets for project teams. Coordinate employee attendance, leave, discipline, and workplace conduct with the HR department. Identify training needs and arrange technical, safety, quality, and supervisory training. Support employee grievance handling and workplace conflict resolution. Ensure project staff follow company rules, policies, and professional standards. Provide management with manpower-performance reports and recommendations. Site Execution and Construction Management Supervise site engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, installers, and labor teams. Ensure façade installation follows approved drawings, method statements, and project specifications. Monitor daily progress, site productivity, safety, material usage, and workmanship. Resolve technical and coordination issues during fabrication and installation. Ensure proper handling, storage, protection, and installation of façade materials. Coordinate with other trades to prevent clashes and delays. Oversee testing, commissioning, snag rectification, cleaning, and project handover. Ensure all projects follow health, safety, and environmental requirements.

job_description: Institute of Applied Health Sciences (IAHS), located at near Foy’s Lake, Khulshi, Chattogram, Bangladesh was founded in 1989 by pre-eminent National Professor Dr. Nurul Islam, an iconic figure in the field of Medical Education in Bangladesh, South Asia and the world. সাবলীলভাবে বুঝিয়ে বলা। যেহেতু  অনেক শিক্ষার্থীর পরিবারে কেউ আগে পড়াশোনা করেনি, তাই কঠিন বৈজ্ঞানিক বা সামাজিক টার্মগুলো সহজ ভাষায় রূপান্তর করা। হাতের  কাছে পাওয়া যায় এমন সাধারণ জিনিসপত্র দিয়ে বিজ্ঞানের উপকরণ তৈরি জাতীয়  শিক্ষাক্রম (NCTB) ঠিক রেখে শিক্ষার্থীদের মেধা ও শেখার গতি অনুযায়ী পড়াশোনা সহজ করা। আশেপাশে  সহজে পাওয়া যায় এমন কম খরচের জিনিসপত্র দিয়ে ক্লাসের জন্য আকর্ষণীয় চার্ট, মডেল বা উপকরণ তৈরি মানসিক ও নৈতিক উন্নয়ন কোনো  শিক্ষার্থী যেন স্কুল ছেড়ে চলে না যায় (ঝরে পড়া রোধে) সেজন্য তাদের নিয়মিত উৎসাহ দেওয়া। পারিবারিক  বা আর্থিক সমস্যার কারণে কোনো বাচ্চার পড়াশোনায় ব্যাঘাত ঘটছে কি না, তা খুঁজে বের করা। শ্রেণীকক্ষে  একটি নিরাপদ, হাসিখুশি ও পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্ন পরিবেশ বজায় রাখা। লেখাপড়ার  পাশাপাশি শিক্ষার্থীদের ভালো আচরণ, নৈতিক মূল্যবোধ, নাগরিক দায়িত্ব ও জীবন গড়ার প্রয়োজনীয় শিক্ষা দেওয়া। অভিভাবক ও ম্যানেজমেন্টের সাথে কাজ করা শিক্ষার  গুরুত্ব বোঝাতে চা বাগানের অভিভাবকদের সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ রাখা ও কাউন্সেলিং করা। শিক্ষার্থীরা  যাতে নিয়মিত স্কুলে আসে, সেজন্য প্রয়োজনে তাদের বাড়িতে যাওয়া সাথে মিলে কাজ করা।

job_description: The Trainer - TVET will be responsible for conducting Technical and Vocational Education and Training for selected participants under The Earth Society’s programmes. The role will focus on building practical skills, improving employability, supporting self-employment opportunities, and preparing participants for wage employment, entrepreneurship, or income-generating activities. Key Training Areas The Trainer - TVET may be required to conduct or support training in one or more of the following areas, based on project design and market demand: • Bank-linked Mobile Financial Services training • Modern craft and handicraft training • Electric vehicle and e-vehicle-related training • Healthcare service training • Hotel and hospitality management training • Information and Communication Technology training • Light engineering industry training • Logistics and supply chain management training • Product packaging methods training • Ready-made garments industry training • Renewable energy and environment-friendly technology training • Hotel or restaurant food service training • Demand-based training for Special Economic Zones, Economic Zones, and Export Processing Zones • Sales and marketing training • Sustainable agriculture and organic farming training • Sustainable aquaculture training • Sustainable dairy production and farm management training • Sustainable fertilizer production training • Sustainable floriculture training • Sustainable advanced farm management training • Traditional and high-demand occupation-based training • Waste recycling and waste management training Key Responsibilities Training Planning and Delivery • Conduct TVET training sessions according to the approved curriculum, module, session plan, competency standard, and project guidelines. • Prepare training plans, lesson plans, practical demonstrations, learning materials, handouts, assessment tools, and training schedules. • Deliver practical and market-oriented training to help participants gain employable and income-generating skills. • Use participatory and hands-on methods, including demonstration, group practice, simulation, workplace-based examples, field exposure, and practical assignments. • Ensure that training sessions are inclusive, safe, engaging, and understandable for youth, women, marginalized groups, and community-level participants. Technical Skills Development • Provide practical training in relevant technical or vocational trades according to project requirements. • Build participants’ knowledge, confidence, and hands-on capacity to perform trade-specific tasks independently. • Guide participants on the proper use of tools, equipment, materials, technology, safety measures, and quality standards. • Ensure that participants understand workplace discipline, productivity, service quality, customer handling, teamwork, and professional behavior. • Support participants to connect their technical skills with job placement, self-employment, entrepreneurship, and local market opportunities. Training Quality and Participant Assessment • Conduct pre-training and post-training assessments to measure participant learning progress. • Monitor participant attendance, participation, performance, skills improvement, and completion status. • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and additional support to participants who need improvement. • Maintain training quality by following the approved curriculum, occupational standards, and project indicators. • Support certification, competency assessment, or skills verification processes when required. Employment and Entrepreneurship Linkage Support • Coordinate with Job Placement Officers, Enterprise Development Officers, SEB Trainers, EDT Trainers, and field teams to prepare participants for employment or self-employment. • Identify job-ready and enterprise-ready participants and refer them to relevant project staff for placement or business support. • Support participants in understanding trade-based employment opportunities, workplace requirements, income potential, and business possibilities. • Assist in collecting information on local market demand, employer needs, trade opportunities, and emerging skills requirements. • Encourage participants to apply their skills for employment, freelancing, self-employment, small business, or income-generating activities. Climate-Smart and Sustainable Skills Promotion • Promote environment-friendly practices, safety standards, resource efficiency, waste reduction, and responsible use of materials during training. • Encourage climate-smart and sustainable livelihood practices in relevant training areas such as renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, aquaculture, dairy, fertilizer production, floriculture, farm management, and waste recycling. • Ensure that participants understand basic occupational health and safety, workplace hygiene, environmental responsibility, and safe handling of tools and equipment. Documentation and Reporting • Maintain accurate records of training attendance, session plans, assessment results, participant performance, photographs, training materials, and practical activity documentation. • Prepare training reports, participant progress updates, assessment summaries, completion reports, and follow-up notes. • Collect and document participant success stories, skill improvement examples, field observations, and employment or self-employment evidence. • Submit all required reports and documents to the supervisor within the given timeline. • Ensure that all training documents are accurate, complete, organized, and aligned with The Earth Society’s reporting standards. Coordination and Communication • Coordinate with the Upazila Manager, Cluster Coordinator, Training Coordinator, Community Mobilizer, Job Placement Officer, Enterprise Development Officer, and other project staff for smooth training implementation. • Support training-related logistics, venue preparation, equipment setup, material distribution, attendance collection, and participant follow-up. • Communicate regularly with participants, field teams, training centers, employers, local businesses, technical institutions, and relevant stakeholders. • Represent The Earth Society professionally during training sessions, field visits, market visits, employer visits, and stakeholder meetings.

স্টোর ও স্থায়ী সম্পদ সম্পর্কিত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা এবং সম্পদের সংরক্ষণ করা। কর্মীর ছাড়পত্র সম্পর্কিত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা। দৈনন্দিন, সাপ্তাহিক, মাসিক, বার্ষিক আর্থিক প্রতিবেদনসহ কর্তৃপক্ষের job_description: Introduction: The Ready-Made-Garments (RMG) Sustainability Council (RSC) is an unprecedented initiative to ensure that garments exported from Bangladesh are produced in safe factories. The RSC carries forward the significant accomplishments made on workplace safety in Bangladesh following the Tazreen fire and Rana Plaza collapse incidents. The RSC conducts structural, electrical, fire, and boiler safety inspections of factories, supports and monitors remediation, conducts safety training and operates an independent safety & health complaints mechanism available to workers in covered RMG factories. Overall Job Purpose: The Remediation Programme Officer (RPO) is an execution-level role within the Remediation Programme of the RMG Sustainability Council (RSC), responsible for implementing and coordinating inspection and remediation activities across assigned factories. The role reports to the Team Leader – Remediation Programme (TL-RP) and plays a key role in ensuring effective execution of programme operations in alignment with organizational protocols, regulatory requirements, and stakeholder expectations. The RPO is responsible for managing day-to-day remediation activities at the factory level, including follow-up and review of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs), coordination of inspection-related actions, and support for escalation processes. The role ensures timely updating of programme data in systems such as FFC/Salesforce, accurate documentation, and consistent tracking of remediation progress. The position supports escalation management by monitoring factory compliance, preparing escalation-related documentation, and coordinating meetings and follow-up actions. The RPO also contributes to handling special investigations and technical queries, ensuring timely communication and coordination among factories, brands, unions, and internal teams. The RPO plays an important role in maintaining accurate records and supporting reporting processes, including document submission tracking, data validation, and maintenance of qualitative and quantitative information for assigned factories. The role also supports monitoring and evaluation activities through factory visits, verification processes, and reporting of critical safety and compliance risks. Through effective coordination, documentation, and follow-up, the RPO ensures timely implementation of remediation actions, supports programme consistency, and contributes to the overall effectiveness of the Inspection and Remediation Programme. Duties and Responsibilities: Corrective Action Planning • Follow up with assigned factories to obtain the latest Corrective Action Plans (CAPs). • Review submitted CAP updates, including action plans and supporting evidence, and provide appropriate comments. • Update CAPs in the database (FFC/Salesforce) and ensure publication on the RSC website. • Track follow-ups and related inspection CAPs and ensure timely system updates. • Prepare meeting factsheets, minutes, and follow up on action points for Finance/Remediation/Technical meetings. Managing Escalations • Follow up with factories scheduled for inspections to ensure participation. • Monitor escalation status, analyze Escalation Assessment Forms (EAF), and prepare recommendations. • Coordinate escalation meetings (Stage 1 & 2). • Prepare escalation meeting factsheets, minutes, and track action points. • Identify uncooperative factories and coordinate with the escalation team. Managing Records & Document Submission • Update the Case Management Tool (CMT) for day-to-day operations. • Ensure inspection reports and CAPs are uploaded to FFC/Salesforce and shared with relevant stakeholders. • Ensure timely submission of required documents (DEA/EA, SLD, FADS, SUPS, SFP, PFP, etc.). • Maintain accurate, detailed, and verified qualitative and quantitative data for assigned factories. • Provide interpretation and translation support as required. • Ensure dispatch of recognition/no-colour letters to eligible factories. • Maintain and update records related to closures, relocations, and remediation finance. • Ensure timely follow-up on direct contribution collection from factories. Managing Special Investigations • Track special investigations and maintain records in the database. • Propose critical cases for factory list review meetings for resolution. • Receive and coordinate responses to technical queries from stakeholders (brands, factories, unions). Overall Monitoring & Evaluation Process • Conduct factory visits (e.g., closure verification, occupancy verification) to monitor worker safety. • Report observed critical health and safety risks. • Alert the Team Leader on issues affecting remediation progress. Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the TL/Management to support organizational objectives.

 ১. পদের সারসংক্ষেপ 
 কমি শেফ কিচেন টিমের একটি প্রাথমিক কিন্তু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পদ, যেখানে কর্মরত ব্যক্তি শেফ দ্য পার্টি, সু শেফ এবং হেড শেফের তত্ত্বাবধানে খাদ্য প্রস্তুত, উপকরণ প্রস্তুতকরণ এবং কিচেনের দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনায় সহায়তা করবেন। 
 এই পদের মূল উদ্দেশ্য হলো প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মান, রেসিপি এবং স্বাস্থ্যবিধি অনুসরণ করে খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপগুলো সম্পন্ন করা, কিচেনের কার্যক্রমকে সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা এবং সিনিয়র শেফদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 ২. প্রধান দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য 
 ক) খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি সহায়তা 
 
 শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী বিভিন্ন খাদ্য উপকরণ প্রস্তুত করা (কাটা, ধোয়া, পরিমাপ করা ইত্যাদি)। 
 নির্ধারিত রেসিপি অনুযায়ী খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপে সহায়তা করা। 
 খাবারের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখতে সতর্কতা অবলম্বন করা। 
 খাবারের সঠিক উপস্থাপন নিশ্চিত করতে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 খ) কিচেন পরিচালনা ও পরিচ্ছন্নতা 
 
 কিচেনের নির্ধারিত কর্মস্থল পরিষ্কার, স্বাস্থ্যসম্মত ও সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা। 
 রান্নাঘরের যন্ত্রপাতি, সরঞ্জাম ও উপকরণ ব্যবহারের পর পরিষ্কার রাখা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নীতিমালা মেনে চলা। 
 
 গ) উপকরণ ব্যবস্থাপনা 
 
 খাদ্য উপকরণ সঠিকভাবে সংরক্ষণ ও ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। 
 উপকরণের সতেজতা ও গুণগত মান পরীক্ষা করা। 
 প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণের ঘাটতি হলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। 
 
 ঘ) টিমওয়ার্ক ও সহযোগিতা 
 
 কিচেন টিমের অন্যান্য সদস্যদের সাথে সমন্বয় রেখে কাজ করা। 
 সিনিয়র শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করা এবং তাদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 ব্যস্ত সময়ে দ্রুত ও দক্ষতার সাথে কাজ সম্পন্ন করা। 
 
 
 ৩. প্রয়োজনীয় যোগ্যতা ও দক্ষতা 
 
 কুলিনারি আর্টস বা ফুড প্রোডাকশন বিষয়ে প্রশিক্ষণ থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। 
 রেস্টুরেন্ট, ক্যাফে বা হোটেল কিচেনে  কমপক্ষে ১–২ বছরের অভিজ্ঞতা  থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার। 
 খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি, রান্নার মৌলিক কৌশল এবং কিচেন ব্যবস্থাপনা সম্পর্কে প্রাথমিক ধারণা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নিয়ম সম্পর্কে সচেতনতা। 
 দলগতভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা এবং দায়িত্বশীল মনোভাব। 
 দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ এবং পেশাদারিত্ব বজায় রাখার মানসিকতা। 
 
 
 ৪. কর্মপরিবেশ ও কর্মঘণ্টা 
 
 রান্নাঘরের পরিবেশে দীর্ঘ সময় দাঁড়িয়ে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে। 
 প্রয়োজনে শিফট ভিত্তিক কাজ, সপ্তাহান্তে বা বিশেষ দিনে কাজ করতে হতে পারে। 
 
 
 ৫. বেতন ও সুবিধা 
 
 প্রার্থীর যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে। 
 প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুবিধা প্রদান করা হবে।
